summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier families from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with strong open-weight competition from DeepSeek, Meta, Mistral, and Alibaba's Qwen. Real-world adoption is driven heavily by enterprise access through cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which amplifies the reach of established, stable model versions beyond direct-API numbers. Because the live research data references several unconfirmed or speculative version names, this ranking is restricted to models whose exact names can be verified in official docs and the provided research.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: The most widely deployed general-purpose model across direct API and Azure OpenAI, consistently topping developer surveys and powering a large share of production workloads.
strengths: Massive enterprise reach via Azure OpenAI
models.best_for: General-purpose assistants and multimodal production applications

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: The default workhorse for coding and agentic workflows, with strong adoption amplified by availability on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Software development and agentic enterprise automation

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google's flagship reasoning model with a huge context window, deeply integrated into Google Cloud Vertex AI and Workspace for broad enterprise consumption.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and multimodal reasoning

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost model favored for scaled production workloads, driving large token volumes through Vertex AI and the Gemini API.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: The leading open-weight reasoning model (671B MoE, 37B active) with massive HuggingFace downloads and extremely low API cost at $0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens.
models.best_for: Reasoning-heavy and math/algorithmic tasks on a budget

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: A hugely popular open-weight general-purpose MoE model delivering near-frontier performance at a fraction of the cost, widely downloaded and self-hosted.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and widely available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI for enterprise self-hosting.

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's leading reasoning model, heavily used for complex coding, math, and agentic tasks, available via the OpenAI API and Azure.
strengths: Reliable on complex math and coding
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, research, and advanced coding tasks

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Europe's leading model choice for data-sovereignty-conscious enterprises, available through Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI.
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments with compliance requirements

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: A top open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads, especially strong adoption in Asia and among the open-source community.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's fast, low-cost tier with strong adoption for high-volume agentic and classification workloads, available via Bedrock and Vertex AI alongside the Claude API.
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive agentic and classification tasks
